processing.word_cut: Designed scissors composite: short blade shear at0, old-paper fibers at.018s, damped mechanism closure at.062s, quiet paper slip at.126s. All recorded layers HP/LP filtered, no ringing tone or white-noise bed. Not a scissors field recording.
processing.word_select: One short supported paper touch, with a very small fiber flex at.026s; smooth tanh peak rounding. No metal, water, sustained slide, pitched chime or magic tail; shorter and quieter than cutting or inserting a card.
processing.ingredient_add: Soft revision: same downward water gesture and .40s duration; splash LP reduced2700->1500Hz, onset6->18ms and tail45->60ms, dry contact reduced, body changed to quiet pure sine240->175Hz, separate late droplet removed. Final whole-event RMS target-40.5dBFS, peak ceiling-22.5dBFS; reference is untouched.
processing.ingredient_remove: Soft revision: same lift then return gesture and .44s duration; splash LP2400->1450Hz, slower27ms onset, two obvious droplets replaced by one low quiet300->235Hz drop, tray contact reduced. Final RMS target-40dBFS, peak ceiling-23dBFS; reference is untouched.

synthesis: Only ingredient revisions use low, pure sine liquid-body gestures. Scissors and card selection are edited CC0 recording composites, without synthetic noise.
common_processing: Mono downmix, resample/speed change, 2-pole HP and6-pole LP, smoothed transient attenuation, soft attack/release, restrained event RMS and peak levels.
dependencies: Python, numpy, scipy, soundfile. Existing local soundfile fallback; no new installation.
